title: Trading OS pages & flow
snippet:
What Screener, Strategy, Discovery, Recommendations, and Review each show — and how stocks flow between them. Strategy is only configuration. Recommended stocks appear on Recommendations after the decision pipeline applies Screeners, Discovery/Evaluation facts, and Strategy rules.

What each page is about:

```text
Page              About                         Data you see
---------------   ---------------------------   ------------------------------------------
Screener          Eligibility rules             Definitions, runs, hit lists
Strategy          Policy / config only          Weights, thresholds, exits, gates (no stock list)
Discovery         Candidates + factor facts     Symbols, long-focused score/confidence/explanation
Recommendations   Final ideas                   Open/Increase/Reduce/Exit + HOLD/WATCH; Approve
Pending Exec.     Approved, not filled yet      Queue + optio

title: Transactions
snippet:
Buy/sell ledger — source of truth for holdings, fees, and realized P/L. Transactions are the ledger of record. Buys and sells drive holdings, average cost, fees, and FIFO realized P/L. Use Active vs Squared-off views, CSV import, and sell prefill from Portfolio. When more than one owner holds the same stock, a sell must name the Strategy or unmanaged lot — Lido does not guess. Sell rows that came from an EXIT recommendation may show a persisted exit_reason (strategy_exit, stop_loss, trailing_stop, horizon_expiry) — displayed with a human label but not recalculated in the UI.

This is the accounting backbone of the app. Enter transactions carefully because holdings, realized P/L, XIRR, and multiple reports derive from this ledger. Prefer editing incorrect rows instead of adding compensating noise rows unless your accounting policy requires audit-style reversals.

title: Pending Execution
snippet:
Approved recommendations waiting for a fill — manual ledger or broker submit. After you Approve a BUY or SELL recommendation, it moves here as pending execution. In Manual mode, you trade at your broker then record the fill in the app (ledger transaction). In Semi-Automatic mode, selecting rows is not execution — use Accept / Execute Selected with your StoX execution code — {Authenticator App Name} to submit to Kite. Automatic mode submits eligible orders without a per-order click. Broker acceptance is not a fill. An actionable broker Recommendation seeks its monetary target over its next two eligible NSE sessions, can make partial progress, and completes only when fills or internal transfers reach that target.

Admin-only catalogue to review stock-master rows and set admin availability overrides. Lists non-benchmark `portfolio_stocks` with server-side search and pagination. **System** (`is_active`) reflects stock-master/provider feed state. **Admin override** (`admin_deactivated`) blocks effective availability without changing feed state. **Effective** availability is `is_active AND NOT admin_deactivated`. Activate clears the override only; Deactivate sets the override only. Neither action creates or deletes stocks. Universe price sync remains on Settings → Universe price sync.

Practical tip: treat this page as one step in a larger workflow, not an isolated screen. Make one change at a time, verify the downstream effect, and use linked pages to complete the loop (for example: discovery → evaluation → recommendation → pending execution → review).
